body:
# 0.8.0

> woaw, first real semver seal release :3

After 2 years, *seal* is now featureful-enough towards its goal of being a cross-platform scripting tool, and is graduating to 0.x.0 release cadence. This means we'll see more frequent, smaller releases (instead of waterfalls), with a version number more suitable for the state of the project.

## Breaking changes

- [_VERSION global changed formats](https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/blob/main/UPDATE.md#breaking-change-to-_version), now recommend using `_RUNTIME` and `_LUAU` instead
- Raw terminal events functionality [moved from @std/io/input to @std/terminal](https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/blob/main/UPDATE.md#breaking-changes-apis-moved)

## Notable new features/improvements since 0.0.7

- Reading and writing archives (zip, tar (5 compression formats), 7z, ar, deb) and compressed files in memory
- New Luau 0.730 features -- classes (experimental), export value, const syntax
- Brand new `@std/net/http` library (full rewrite) with many new features
- Writing TUIs with `@std/io/terminal` and `@std/io/cursor`
- `input.read` for reading to EOF with an optional arbitrary byte/size count and an optional timeout
- Beautiful and configurable table formatting with guidelines and snowflakes ❄️
- Pass custom globals to `luau.eval`
- `print` standard library functions at runtime to see their type signatures.

... and more, [see all new features](https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/blob/main/UPDATE.md)

body:
This release provides some incremental improvements to *seal* as well as a highly requested feature -- native bindings. Now you can write dynamic library plugins in Rust (or another language) and directly load them in *seal* with `@interop/extern`'s `extern.load`. See [external-libraries.md](https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/blob/main/docs/external_libraries.md)

This also updates us to Luau 0.709 to patch a use-after-free vulnerability in Luau's `table.find`.

Please note that the next *seal* version, 0.0.8, will contain multiple breaking changes to the `@std/net/http` API, which will be wholly rewritten, as well as renames of some methods in `@std/fs`.

## Breaking changes
- `env.getvar/setvar/etc.` are deprecated; use the `env.vars` lib instead.
- `process.spawn`'s `ChildProcess`' streams can now be nil if `stdio = "Inherit"`. By default, nothing should change, so you can cast the result of `process.spawn` to `process.PipedChild` without changing any other code.

## Added

- `extern.load` Bind to dynamic libraries as an alternative to FFI (foreign function interface).
- `stdio = "Inherit"` and environment variables options to `process.spawn` API.
- Pretty error messages that show the lines of code near the cause of a runtime error.
- JIT support enabled by default so *seal* is a lot faster
- Websocket client support.
- Implemented `env.vars` library and deprecated the `env.getvar/etc.` APIs. It supports `.env` files!
- `env.arch` and `thread.parallelism`
- A `seal regen` command that regenerates typedefs in existing projects for use after updating *seal*
- Support for Luau's explicit type instantiation syntax.
- New terminal editing apis: `prompt.edit` and `input.editline`

## Known issues

- Pretty error messages don't display properly when the error message string itself is multiple lines.
- Pretty error messages' syntax highlighting isn't great inside string literals
- `seal regen` isn't listed in `seal help`

## Changelog
* ZstdOptions - better defaults and compatibility by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/133
* Add websocket client support, cache require resolver and output formatter by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/134
* Update mluau and other dependencies by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/137
* Pretty error messages by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/138
* Enable JIT by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/140
* Implement env.vars library with dotenv support by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/141
* `process.spawn`: add stdio options and environment variables by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/146
* Fix panics, robustness, add crash logs by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/152
* Fix linking on Android due to Luau JIT by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/153
* prompt.pick: fix options cleanup, accept directly typing option index by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/154
* Fix: p, pp, and dp should return their input values by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/156
* extern.load - load shared libraries at runtime by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/123
* Implement env.arch by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/160
* Implement `thread.parallelism` by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/161
* Update dependencies again by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/163
* Pass C-Stack API to external libraries in `extern.load` by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/165
* Correction for the description of `luaL_typename` by @PhoenixWhitefire in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/166
* seal regen by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/169

* Explicit type instantiation and seal bundle fixes by @deviaze in https://github.com/seal-runtime/seal/pull/178

body:
# Changes
## New features
- `@std/args`
- `@std/io/prompt` and lower-level `@std/io/input` functions to watch input and build TUI.
- File watching with `fs.watch`.
- `@std/time` and `@std/datetime`, the latter of which supports full UTC-aware DateTimes and DateTime and TimeSpan arithmetic.
- `seal compile` and `@interop/standalone`.
- `@std/err` for nominal error handling (temporarily needs an FFlag to fix)
- `@std/semver`
- Multiple serialization and compression libraries.
- Pretty print and debug print formatting for buffers with hexdumps
- Documentation in markdown.
- `fs.is`, `fs.symlink`, `fs.unsymlink`.
- `fs.dir.*` methods for path helping.
- Explicit closing of process stdin
- `colors.style.underline`
- Moves table formatting to its dedicated library.
- Adds zed support (will be improved later)

## Fixes

Many bugs, including:

- table printing performance
- handle unix roots correctly in `fs.path.join`
- `io.output.write/ewrite` being unable to write non-utf8 bytes to stdout/stderr.
- Multiple panics.

body: Looks like [luau-lsp updated to the new `init.luau` require-by-string semantics](https://github.com/JohnnyMorganz/luau-lsp/pull/1024) without a backwards-compatibility option, breaking our type definitions with the newest luau-lsp. seal wants to be current with luau and `luau-lsp` so we're updating to `@self` type definitions without a compatibility option for now. Note that seal still supports the old resolution semantics at runtime but it won't be the default anymore either
name: v0.0.5-rc.2 - use `@self` in `.typedefs` and new `init.luau` semantics by default

body:
## Features
- `env.cwd()` replaces `env.current_working_directory`
- `fs.path.normalize(path: string)`
- support for `@self` and new `init.luau` require resolution semantics (both are supported, seal will fallback to the new semantics if a module isn't found)
- require resolution takes into account all `.luaurc`s, not just the closest one
- `--version`
- `--help` actually displays helpful stuff now, though it's a wip
- update to latest mlua 0.10.3 (latest git commit) which fixes issues with integer interop
- `pcall` return type now typed as `(boolean, T | error)` to (somewhat) better represent errors in mlua. (note that `typeof(err)` still returns `userdata` and i'll look into fixing that later)

## Fixes
- rewrote require resolver; requires should now work like they're supposed to and be well tested
- `seal run` not assigning the correct chunk debug names, same issue as running files with seal without a `./` prefix
- lots of really weird edge cases with UNC paths on windows (like `\\?\C:\Users`...) affecting pathlib functions and require resolution on windows
- `process.shell` on Windows and various bugs with it and `process.run`
- big numbers incorrectly serializing to mlua LuaNumbers instead of LuaInteger
name: v0.0.5-rc.1 - requires fixed!
